messages:
tess: quick flag  I ran into a broken fragment while following the runtime guide: https://kb.redwood.ai/serving/runtime#kv_cache_deepdive — page loads but the fragment doesn't resolve. looks like the current heading generates `#kv-cache-deep-dive`.

omar: thanks. prod or staging? can you paste the exact url you clicked?

tess: prod link above. `curl -I -L https://kb.redwood.ai/serving/runtime.html#kv_cache_deepdive` returns 200 but no scroll. local grep found references in a workshop and an onboarding snippet.

ben: probable cause is a heading rename underscores -> hyphens or added punctuation. We should avoid wide sed on the repo without a preview.

lisa: I touched that section earlier this month when I split examples. happy to own a small patch to update callers and add `owners:` to frontmatter.

tess: draft command I used to find occurrences (in a branch):

```
# show files that reference the old fragment
git grep -n "kv_cache_deepdive" || true
# then edit those files manually or with editorscript
```

omar: prefer editing the files directly and opening a PR. also add a line in the PR body: "doc: fix orphan fragment in runtime guide" so release notes capture it.

docs-bot: scheduled link-check (prod) reported fragment failure: `/serving/runtime.html#kv_cache_deepdive` -> issue #4987 created.

ben: plan: lisa opens PR updating 4 files, add `owners: "@lisa"` in runtime frontmatter, and leave a follow-up issue for a docs linter that warns on mismatched fragments. I'll volunteer to write the linter rule next sprint.

lisa: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1307 — updates in `guides/onboarding.md`, `workshops/kv-cache.md`, `runtime/runtime.md`, and `internal/snippets.md`. CI preview running. cc @ben @omar

tess: small suggestion for the PR body: include the exact files changed and a short test note: "preview shows fragment jump working". helps triage.

omar: reviewing now. tiny nit: change the frontmatter owners to use team handle `@docs/runtime` instead of an individual so ownership persists across rotations.

lisa: done, updated PR to `owners: "@docs/runtime"`. thanks.

docs-bot: CI preview: link-check pass for updated pages. No remaining fragment failures for `/serving/runtime`.

ben: merging after a quick review. after merge I'll create issue to add the linter and link it to the docs CI.

tess: awesome, thanks everyone. resolving. if the bot re-finds anything I'll re-open the thread.
